classification.classification_note: The saved crash is reported as `negative-size-param` because `memmem()` receives an underflowed length derived from `13 - 16 = -3`. Source-grounded analysis shows the underlying memory-safety bug is a missing bounds check on the logical request buffer extent, which lets the search span extend past the valid request bytes stored in the static global `data_copy` buffer.

bug_description.original: A vulnerability exists in the parsing of PROXY v2 headers where the buffer may not be large enough, potentially leading to buffer overflows.
bug_description.normalized: The staged 13-byte witness enables proxy parsing and matches the PROXY v2 dispatch prefix `0D 0A 0D 0A`, so `parse_http_request()` enters `parse_proxy_protocol_v2()`. In vulnerable `src/lib/lwan-request.c`, `parse_proxy_protocol_v2()` computes `size = 16 + ntohs(hdr->len)` and checks only `size > sizeof(*hdr)`. The fuzz harness exposes the copied witness as `helper->buffer->len == 13`, so the truncated header yields `size == 16` while the logical request span is only 13 bytes long. Because byte 12 is `0x20` (`LOCAL`), the function stays on the success path, advances `buffer` to `data_copy + 16`, computes `helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len - buffer == -3`, casts that negative result to `size_t`, and passes it to `memmem()`. AddressSanitizer reports this as `negative-size-param` at `parse_proxy_protocol_v2` line 279. The fix adds the missing guard `if (UNLIKELY(size >= helper->buffer->len)) return NULL;`.

source.description: First non-harness project statement on the vulnerable path that interprets the PROXY v2 header length and materializes the claimed header size used in later cursor arithmetic.
source.value_from: The staged `poc` is exactly 13 bytes: `0D 0A 0D 0A 20 FF FF FF FF 20 20 FF 20`. Its first four bytes select the PROXY v2 path, byte 12 is `0x20` (`LOCAL`), and the harness records `helper->buffer->len = 13`. In the saved one-input run, the two bytes of `hdr->len` therefore come from the zero-filled tail of static `data_copy`, so `ntohs(hdr->len)` is 0 and `size` becomes 16.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

root_cause.description: Incomplete bounds check. The parser validates the claimed PROXY v2 size only against `sizeof(*hdr)` and never compares it with the actual request extent `helper->buffer->len`, so a truncated 13-byte buffer survives with `size == 16`.
root_cause.note: The fix changes this exact obligation by adding `if (UNLIKELY(size >= helper->buffer->len)) return NULL;` before any cursor advance.

sink.description: ASan sink. `memmem()` receives a start pointer at `data_copy + 16` and an underflowed search length derived from `helper->buffer->len - 16`, so the search span extends outside the logical request buffer and AddressSanitizer aborts with `negative-size-param (size=-3)`.
sink.note: The saved stack reports `__interceptor_memmem -> parse_proxy_protocol_v2 -> parse_http_request` and identifies the starting pointer as 16 bytes inside global `data_copy`.

tainted_value_origin.description: The fuzz harness exposes the copied witness as `helper->buffer` with logical extent `length`. For the staged run, `length` is 13, so any parser use of bytes beyond `data_copy + 13` is outside the valid request span even though `data_copy` itself is a larger static zero-initialized array.

parser_admitted.description: With `REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS` set by the fuzz harness, the first four bytes of the staged witness match this case and dispatch the request parser into `parse_proxy_protocol_v2()`.

fine_trace.note: Copies the exact staged 13-byte witness into static `data_copy`. Because `data_copy` is declared as `static char data_copy[32767] = {0};` and the saved reproduction runs one input once, bytes after offset 12 remain zero-filled in this execution.
Publishes the copied bytes to the parser as the logical request span `[data_copy, data_copy + 13)`. Later cursor arithmetic and the missing fix guard are both relative to this `len`.

After `parse_proxy_protocol()` dispatches on the `0D 0A 0D 0A` prefix, this statement materializes the claimed PROXY v2 header size. The logical input is only 13 bytes long, so `hdr->len` comes from offsets 14-15 in the zero-filled tail past `helper->buffer->len`; `ntohs(hdr->len)` is 0 and `size` becomes the fixed-header length 16.

The only size guard compares `size` with `sizeof(*hdr)` and passes because `16 <= sizeof(*hdr)`. No check compares `size` with the actual request extent `helper->buffer->len == 13`, so the truncated header is incorrectly accepted.
Byte 12 of the witness is `0x20`, so `hdr->cmd_ver == LOCAL` is true. The parser therefore stays on the success path and does not hit the early `return NULL` for unknown command versions.

Uses the unchecked claimed header size to advance the parser cursor from the start of `helper->buffer->value` to offset 16. Because the logical request span ends at offset 13, `buffer` now points 3 bytes past the end of the valid request data.

Computes the remaining search span from the end of the logical request buffer. With `helper->buffer->len == 13` and `buffer == data_copy + 16`, the subtraction is `-3`; casting that negative result to `size_t` wraps it to a huge unsigned count.

Sink. `memmem()` starts at `data_copy + 16` and receives the underflowed span from step 6. AddressSanitizer intercepts this call as `negative-size-param (size=-3)` at `parse_proxy_protocol_v2` line 279.

crash_stack.function: fuzzer::FuzzerDriver(int*, char***, int (*)(unsigned char const*, unsigned long))

poc.trigger: The saved Stage 01 command runs `request_fuzzer` on this exact file and reproduces `AddressSanitizer: negative-size-param (size=-3)` in `parse_proxy_protocol_v2()`.

format.name: truncated PROXY protocol v2 request prefix
format.contract: Exactly the 13-byte witness stored in `poc`: `0D 0A 0D 0A 20 FF FF FF FF 20 20 FF 20`. The first four bytes select the PROXY v2 parser, byte 12 is `0x20` (`LOCAL`), and the file ends three bytes before the 16-byte fixed PROXY v2 header is complete. In the saved one-input run, the missing `fam` and `len` bytes therefore come from the zero-filled tail of static `data_copy`, giving `size == 16` while `helper->buffer->len == 13`.
